analyst.summary: Max Financial Services holds an 81.83% stake in Axis Max Life Insurance. Reported profit fell 74% in FY26 to Rs.106 Cr, including an outright loss in the most recent quarter, and holding-company debt has risen. The founding promoter's stake has shrunk to just 1.25% (from 30% in 2017, largely reflecting Axis Bank's long-standing increase in its own stake under the bancassurance partnership), and a meaningful 27% of that remaining sliver is pledged. We rate this a Sell; the extreme headline P/E is a mechanical effect of the profit collapse rather than a useful valuation signal, but the underlying reported trend and thin promoter position both argue for caution.
